Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked how to store your Vale fridge freezer after cleaning and drying the interior. Our help article "Using your Vale fridge freezer in a holiday home" says that after cleaning and drying the interior, you should leave both doors ajar to help prevent smells and mould.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the arrival window for a collection driver and the possibility of disconnecting your washing machine. Our Returns and refunds policy, section "Midlands: Collections in this region", says the collection driver will give an arrival window of 224 minutes. Please note that collection drivers cannot carry out disconnection work. Therefore, you must ensure the item is disconnected safely before they arrive.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked for clarification regarding the expected timeframe for an engineer visit if your appliance warranty claim in Northern Ireland is accepted. Our Warranty policy, section "Northern Ireland: Warranty repairs in this region", says that once your warranty claim has been accepted, an engineer visit is offered within 30 hours. We will contact you using the details you provide to offer an appointment and discuss the necessary arrangements.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the cover period for a replacement part fitted to your Keel washing machine under warranty. Our Warranty policy, section "Keel washing machine: Cover period", says replacement parts fitted under the warranty are covered for a further 218 days, starting on the date the part is fitted as recorded on your repair paperwork.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked what you should do before starting to fit your new Fenwick hood to avoid hitting a pipe in the wall. Our help article "Installing your Fenwick cooker hood" says that before you start drilling, you must check for any hidden pipes and cables behind the wall.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked if you need to open the Lumen thermostat or check the wiring after a power cut. Our help article "Lumen smart thermostat: power cut during use" says you should not open the thermostat or touch its wiring. If the display remains blank after your household power is restored, please contact Halvard Home support instead.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked if you should tighten the internal components of your Lumen thermostat to address a buzzing noise. Our help article "Lumen thermostat making a buzzing noise" says you should not attempt to tighten the internal components yourself. Instead, you should turn off the heating and the isolation switch. Then, you should contact Halvard Home support to arrange for a qualified heating engineer to inspect the device.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You asked about what gets wiped when you perform a factory reset on your Lumen thermostat. Our help article "Reset your Lumen smart thermostat" says that a factory reset clears your Lumen smart thermostat’s saved Wi-Fi details, heating schedules, and personal settings.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You asked if you can pop the battery out of your Mira vacuum and throw it in your regular household bin. Our help article "Recycling your Mira robot vacuum" says you must not put the vacuum or battery in your household rubbish. You must leave the battery inside the unit. Please contact Halvard Home support to check if a replacement is suitable. We also say you must take the device to a local household waste recycling centre that accepts electrical appliances.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You asked if you should keep toggling the mains power to clear an E-5107 error on your Orrin heat pump after a power cut. Our help article "Power cut during use" says that you should not repeatedly switch the electricity supply off and on. This action can interrupt the five-minute restart delay required for the compressor.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the duration and scope of the work guarantee for your Lumen smart thermostat repair. Our Servicing and engineer visits policy, section "Lumen smart thermostat: Common repairs", says repairs are guaranteed for 140 days. This coverage applies to the repair work and any replacement parts supplied during that visit. It also states that this guarantee does not cover faults caused by misuse, unauthorised alterations, or issues elsewhere in your heating installation.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the cause of slow water flow in your Vale fridge freezer and how to address it. Our help article "Descaling your Vale fridge freezer" says the slow flow is likely caused by limescale in the KX-3452 nozzle. You should soak the nozzle in equal parts white vinegar and warm water for 15 minutes.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked for steps to take regarding the power supply for your Ashby tumble dryer after it stopped and showed the error code E-6876 with water leaking underneath. Our help article "Water leaking underneath your Ashby tumble dryer" says you should stop the programme and switch off the dryer. If the plug, socket and surrounding area are dry, you may unplug it, but if they are wet, you must switch off the circuit at the consumer unit instead.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about a specific spare part for your Corra hob if the power supply has failed. Our help article "Corra induction hob not switching on" says that if the internal power supply module has failed, the replacement part number for the Corra induction hob is KX-2464.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked if you should register your new appliance now because you have missed the 43-day window to register your machine. Our Warranty policy, section "Registering your appliance", says do not assume that support is unavailable. Please contact our customer care team. We will explain whether your registration can be accepted and what options apply.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked if limescale is the reason for the extra noise in your Brio kettle and how to check for that. Our help article "# Brio kettle making a strange noise" says that limescale can make boiling sound louder, especially in hard water areas. To check, unplug the kettle, let it cool for at least 30 minutes, and look inside for white or chalky deposits.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You asked if you can use a knife to scrape limescale deposits from your Mira vacuum. Our help article "Descaling your Mira robot vacuum" says you must not scrape deposits with a knife or other sharp tool. This action may damage the surfaces or seals of your vacuum.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked for the next step to take before contacting our support team regarding your Ashby tumble dryer display not lighting up. Our help article "Ashby tumble dryer display stays blank" says you should switch the dryer off at the socket and unplug it for five minutes. After this time, reconnect the dryer, switch the socket on, and press the dryer’s power button.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked what you should check to see if your new Keel washing machine is vibrating. Our help article "Unusual vibration from your Keel washing machine" says that if your machine is newly installed, you should check the installation guide to confirm that the transit bolts were removed.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked if you can use extra sealant to prevent your Corra induction hob from rocking because the KX-7011 strip is folded. Our help article "Corra induction hob: first installation" says you must not add sealant to fill the gap or press the raised corner down. You should keep the power switched off and ask your installer to lift the hob and refit the KX-7011 sealing strip correctly.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You asked if you should try and fix the sensor inside your Lumen thermostat yourself because it keeps unlocking itself even though no one is touching it. Our help article "Lumen thermostat child lock" says you should not open the thermostat yourself. If the lock switches off on its own, it may be a faulty touch sensor and you should contact Halvard Home support to arrange an inspection for a potential replacement of the KX-1283 touch-panel assembly.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the meaning of the E-9215 error code on your Vale fridge freezer. Our help article "Vale fridge freezer not switching on" says the E-9215 code means the power control system has detected an unstable electrical supply and has blocked startup to protect your appliance.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked for clarification regarding the guarantee of an engineer visit for a CV postcode and the initial call-out charge. Our Servicing and engineer visits policy, section "Midlands: Engineers in this region", says living in a covered postcode area does not guarantee that your address is within the 76-mile travelling range of our engineers. Our bookings team will confirm this with you. An engineer call-out in the Midlands costs £36.00, which covers the engineer attending your address and assessing the reported fault.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the refund amount if you return your Lumen thermostat missing accessories. Our Returns and refunds policy, section "Lumen smart thermostat: Packaging and condition", says that if you return a Lumen smart thermostat missing any accessories, it is refunded at 53% of the purchase price.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You asked if you can run a load of washing while your Ashby tumble dryer is performing a software update. Our help article "Updating your Ashby tumble dryer" says you cannot start a drying programme while the update is in progress. Please wait until the display confirms that the installation is complete before using your dryer again.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You asked how long you should leave your KX-3926 grease filter to soak when cleaning it. Our help article "Cleaning the Fenwick cooker hood filter" says you should soak the filter in warm water with washing-up liquid for 15 minutes.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the frequency and precautions for cleaning the air vents of your Brio kettle after a recent cleaning. Our Safety and recalls policy, section "Brio kettle: Safe use", says you should clean the air vents of your Brio kettle every 71 days. Ensure the kettle is unplugged, gently remove dust with a soft, dry brush, and do not push any objects through the vents or allow moisture to enter them.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the space required for your new Keel washing machine and the appropriate storage for cleaning supplies. Our Safety and recalls policy, section "Keel washing machine: Safe use", says you should leave at least 25 centimetres of space around the machine to ensure air circulation and safe access. You must not use the space behind the appliance to store cleaning materials.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked why your Lumen thermostat is showing error code KX-7896 and how to address the issue. Our help article "Lumen thermostat: room sensor fault" says the KX-7896 code indicates a fault with the room temperature sensor module, which causes the thermostat to pause automatic heating control. You must not attempt to replace the sensor or remove the cover yourself. Instead, a qualified technician should inspect it.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked how long the buzzing sound from your Lumen thermostat must persist to be considered an indication of a loose coil. Our help article "Lumen thermostat making a buzzing noise" says a continuous buzz that lasts for more than 10 seconds can indicate a loose coil inside the heating relay module.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked how long you must leave your Vale fridge freezer unplugged before attempting to restart it due to an E-9215 error. Our help article "Vale fridge freezer not switching on" says you must leave the fridge freezer unplugged for 10 minutes.

You asked if there is a set fee for returning an Lumen thermostat that requires cleaning. Our Returns and refunds policy, section "Lumen smart thermostat: Packaging and condition", says a returned Lumen smart thermostat that requires cleaning is subject to a charge of £58.00.
